outcome: Medication purchases for atopic diseases (antihistamines, eczema medication, asthma medication, Epinephrine)
cohort: The study included 559,077 Finnish children born between 1995 and 2004.
finding: Having older siblings was associated with a lower probability of atopic medication purchases, and this protective effect remained significant across all medication types even after accounting for confounding factors, supporting the microbiota hypothesis.
